en: Sepia-toned image of a Gothic stone relief showing the Crucifixion of Christ. In the center, Jesus is on the cross above a skull, flanked by soldiers and saints below, while above him a row of seated figures, likely apostles or prophets, sit in niches beneath small arches. The style suggests a medieval cathedral façade or tympanum, reproduced as an old photograph suitable for a devotional or art-history postcard.
